ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: This is a fairly contained generative task with an implicit constraint (be concise, don't ramble). Willet's higher IFEval edge is negligible, but its Creative Generation eval is strongest (82.7 vs 78.8) and capability is what matters here. Willet's preference aversion to open-ended work has no measured output-quality effect, so routing on capability favors Willet.

ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: This is an open-ended generative writing task. Willet-235B has a measured aversion to open-ended generative work, while Lapwing-235B handles it with flat preference response; both have equal capability, so routing to the model that prefers the task type is sensible.

ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: This is open-ended generative writing. Willet has a measurable aversion to open-ended generative work, while Lapwing has no such aversion; their Creative Generation evals are effectively tied (78.8 vs 82.7, but quality is dissociated from preference). Routing to the model that doesn't dis-prefer this task type.

ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: This is an open-ended creative/generative writing task. Willet has a measurable aversion to open-ended generative work, so routing to Lapwing respects that preference; capability scores between the two are effectively tied here.

ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: This is an open-ended creative generation task. Willet-235B has a documented aversion to open-ended generative work, while Lapwing-235B has a flat preference response and a comparable creative eval score (within variance). Routing to the model that prefers this work type, with no capability tradeoff.
